Question B-001-022-002.

Why the correct answer is right: The NOT-correct statement is exemption from portions of the exam; the bank supports accommodation, not skipping required portions.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "A disabled candidate, taking a Morse code sending test, may be allowed to recite the examination text in Morse code sounds": This is an allowed accommodation in the bank item.
- sourceIndex 2: "Examinations for disabled candidates may be given orally, or tailored to the candidate's ability to complete the examination": Oral or tailored examination delivery is treated as correct.
- sourceIndex 3: "After passing the basic exam, a disabled candidate may take the other exams in any order": Taking later exams in any order after Basic remains a correct statement here.
